title: The Scar
author: Miéville, China
review: I struggled with Perdido and had heard nothing but good things about this one and...it was absolutely true, went above and beyond my high expectations. Absolutely masterful book and perfectly put together, probably will be my favorite book this year. Will be thinking about this one for a long time to come. Amazing world building and some really great subtle character work. Extremely impressive piece of art that was paced extraordinarily well and had such richness, depth, and epic scale. For so much of the ground work he put in on this world to come together in this way is just incredible, cannot recommend this enough.
